forbidden: remove or rename a core section
make PROJECT_BACKGROUND, PROJECT_OBJECTIVE or NETWORK_TOPOLOGY optional

sol_preparation_forward_extension.purpose: reuse the SDS Preparation root for PRE-04 version lifecycle without changing PRE-02 current/readiness semantics
markerRules: PRE_02 uses existing current_marker only and draft_marker/effective_marker are NULL
PRE_04 uses draft_marker/effective_marker only and current_marker is NULL
PRE_04 DRAFT has draft_marker=1 and effective_marker=NULL
PRE_04 current effective COMPLETED has effective_marker=1 and draft_marker=NULL
PRE_04 historical COMPLETED has both markers NULL
sol_preparation_forward_extension.contentVersionPolicy: PRE_04 starts at 0, increments with each successful draft content/file mutation, freezes at completion and is not changed when effective_marker is later cleared; PRE_02 keeps it NULL
sol_preparation_forward_extension.pre02Compatibility: existing readiness columns, status codes, indexes and current_marker contract remain unchanged
sol_preparation_forward_extension.pre04ReadinessColumns: readiness-specific fields are not exposed or consumed for PRE-04 and retain neutral storage defaults; they never define PRE-04 completion or SCH readiness

sol_requirement_analysis_section.purpose: one frozen PRE-04 core or extension section inside one preparation business version
sol_requirement_analysis_section.immutability: COMPLETED section content and file facts have stable query only; the root may only clear effective_marker when a later version completes

stateAxes.forbidden: one current marker that makes a new draft replace the still-effective completed input

stateMachine.initialize: no PRE-04 rows -> create businessVersion=1 DRAFT with draft_marker=1
stateMachine.firstComplete: DRAFT -> COMPLETED; clear draft_marker and set effective_marker=1 atomically
stateMachine.createNextDraft: copy current effective COMPLETED to businessVersion+1 DRAFT with source_preparation_id and draft_marker=1; old effective remains unchanged
stateMachine.completeNextDraft: lock expected draft and current effective; validate and revalidate files; clear old effective marker; change draft to COMPLETED, clear draft marker and set effective marker in one transaction
stateMachine.completedImmutability: no command updates or deletes COMPLETED section/content/file/completion facts; only the later-completion transaction may clear the old root effective_marker

transactions.createDraft: LOCK_AND_REVALIDATE_PROJECT_MANAGER; LOCK_CURRENT_EFFECTIVE_AND_DRAFT_MARKER; VALIDATE_IF_MATCH_AND_NO_EXISTING_DRAFT; COPY_ROOT_AND_SECTIONS_AND_EXACT_FILE_REFERENCES; INSERT_DRAFT_MARKER; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT
transactions.complete: LOCK_PROJECT_AND_CURRENT_MANAGER; LOCK_EXPECTED_DRAFT_CURRENT_EFFECTIVE_AND_ALL_SECTIONS; VALIDATE_REQUIRED_AND_FROZEN_SCHEMA; LOCK_AND_REVALIDATE_ALL_EXACT_FILE_FACTS; CLEAR_OLD_EFFECTIVE_MARKER; CAS_DRAFT_TO_COMPLETED_AND_SWITCH_MARKERS; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT

publicRequirementAnalysisApi.readOnlyPolicy: inspect and lockAndRevalidate write no PRE-04, SCH or PLT business facts
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.consumerPolicy: future SCH-01 stores the selected preparationId and businessVersion and owns prefill, input-difference and solution-version behavior
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.historicalPolicy: an explicit historical COMPLETED version remains readable and lockable with isCurrentEffective=false and current effective identifiers; F-SOL-003 does not decide SCH input-difference handling
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.unknownPolicy: missing, cross-tenant, DRAFT, non-COMPLETED, invalid file or any expected content/project/template fact change fails closed

dependencies.projectParticipantAndScope: consume ProjectParticipantFactApi and ProjectScopeApi; roles do not imply descendant scope
dependencies.fileArtifact: consume F-PLT-001 exact reference inspect/lockAndRevalidate and access-ticket APIs; SOL stores no body, URL or infra fact
dependencies.solution: future SCH-01 consumes publicRequirementAnalysisApi; F-SOL-003 writes no Solution or reference row
dependencies.events: none; approved SDS boundary is synchronous query or command

permissions.frontendBackendTruth: server projects allowedActions and revalidates trusted tenant, function, ProjectStageScope, current subject, state and version

platformFacts.fileFacts: exact FileArtifact version and reference only
platformFacts.richTextAuditPolicy: audit controlled before/after summaries and identifiers, never copy sensitive full body or attachment content

legacy.policy: gap and migration-source evidence only; no current truth, no dual write and no inferred completion
reusableSlices: Yudao and Element Plus editor patterns

seedRequirements: PRE-04 catalogVersion=1 and eleven core section labels
representative project WorkBinding configurations for no extension, multiple extension field types and disabled dictionary rejection
